retrievalProfile.description: A centered photographic portrait enclosed in a thick rounded-corner frame, set against a subtly patterned cream background with wide-tracked serif typography.
excludeWhen: dark or industrial aesthetics are requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A central rectangular photograph with rounded corners and a thick dark border, featuring a subject lying in a bed of flowers. The entire composition is nested within a larger cream-colored canvas featuring a faint, repeating geometric line pattern. Elegant, high-contrast serif text is positioned symmetrically above and below the central frame.
coreVisualRelationships: The dark green frame anchors the vibrant photographic subject against the neutral background.
The wide letter-spacing of the typography mirrors the expansive, airy feel of the cream canvas.
The floral elements in the photo bridge the gap between the organic subject and the structured geometric pattern of the background.
coreInvariants: Thick, rounded-corner border around the central image
Subtle, low-opacity geometric pattern on the outer canvas
High-contrast, thin-stroke serif typography with extreme tracking

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centrally located within a rounded rectangular frame that occupies approximately 60% of the total canvas height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The dark green frame acts as the primary visual anchor, separating the saturated photo from the desaturated background.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the large top header, moves down through the central portrait, and rests on the smaller footer text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space is provided by the cream background, creating a sophisticated, breathable layout.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cream/Off-white background with a subtle tan pattern.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Dark forest green for the frame and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant pinks and yellows within the central photograph.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the central image contrasts with the low-saturation, high-value background.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure black; use deep green or charcoal for dark elements.

letterConstructionRules: Large x-height for readability despite thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' features a graceful, curved leg
The 'G' has a sharp, defined chin
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Use the same typeface family for both header and footer, varying only the scale to maintain a unified, high-fashion look.
graphicDevices: Rounded rectangular frame with a 2pt to 4pt stroke

preserve: High contrast between thick and thin strokes

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary high contrast and elegance for a fashion-forward look.
Offers a slightly more organic, pastoral feel while maintaining serif sophistication.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cream-colored background with a faint, repeating geometric pattern. Place a central horizontal photograph of a person lying in flowers, enclosed in a dark green rounded-corner frame.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply centered, uppercase serif text above and below the frame using a high-contrast font with very wide tracking in dark green.

verificationChecks: Is the frame corner radius consistent?
Is the text tracking sufficiently wide to feel 'airy'?
Is the background pattern subtle enough not to distract from the text?
Is the color of the text and frame a matching dark green?

adjustableVariables: Corner radius of the central frame
Amount of letter spacing in the typography
mustRedesign: Any specific logos in the corners
The specific facial features of the subject

mustAchieve: Soft, pastoral lighting in the photograph

postGenerationChecks: Check for centered alignment of all elements.
Ensure the background pattern is visible but low-contrast.
Verify the serif font has high stroke contrast.
Confirm the rounded corners of the frame are smooth and intentional.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Portrait + Rounded Frame + Wide-Tracked Serif + Patterned Neutral Canvas
